description: Tests commodity eligibility rules are driven by DB (port_trade, planet_goods, commodities.illegal) rather than hardcoded lists

tests.name: Setup: Auth test users for commodity tests
T1: Verify new commodity can be added without code changes (ALT test)
tests.description: T1 demonstrates commodity-agnostic system: ALT (3-char code for test commodity) works in ship_cargo without server recompile

sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('ALT', 'Alternate Tech', false, 100, 5);
INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) SELECT p.port_id, 'ALT', 'buy', 1000 FROM ports p WHERE p.port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports LIMIT 1);

tests.name: T2.1: Port trade list is DB-driven (legal commodity)
tests.description: T2 verifies port.trade command queries port_trade table, not hardcoded lists

tests.name: T2.2: Port trade list includes ORE (standard commodity)
T3.1: Alignment gating - good player cannot buy illegal DRG
tests.description: T3 verifies illegal commodity filtering based on commodities.illegal flag and player alignment

tests.name: T3.2: Alignment gating - evil player CAN buy illegal DRG
tests.description: T3.2 verifies evil alignment bypasses illegal commodity restrictions

sql: UPDATE players SET alignment = -1000 WHERE player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE username = 'comm_test_evil');

tests.name: T4.1: Planet deposit uses DB list (no hardcoded ORE/ORG/EQU restriction)
tests.description: T4 verifies planet.deposit checks planet_goods table, allowing any commodity found there

sql: INSERT INTO planets (sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, population, type, creator, created_by) VALUES (1, 'Test Planet Deposit', 1, 'player', 'M', 0, 1, 'test', 1);
INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id, commodity, quantity, max_capacity, production_rate) SELECT p.planet_id, 'ORE', 0, 1000000, 0 FROM planets p WHERE p.name = 'Test Planet Deposit';
INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id, commodity, quantity, max_capacity, production_rate) SELECT p.planet_id, 'DRG', 0, 1000000, 0 FROM planets p WHERE p.name = 'Test Planet Deposit';

tests.name: T4.2: Good player deposits ORE (standard commodity)
T4.3: Good player cannot deposit DRG (illegal) - alignment check
T4.4: Evil player deposits DRG (illegal) - alignment allows it

sql: UPDATE ship_cargo SET quantity = 5 WHERE commodity_code = 'DRG' AND ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE owner_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE username = 'comm_test_evil') LIMIT 1);

tests.name: Regression: Phase 1 test - mixed cargo capacity still enforced
tests.description: Verify Phase 1 holds enforcement not broken by Phase 2 refactoring

assertions.name: DB-driven port trade: Port 1 trades ORE via port_trade table
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM port_trade WHERE commodity = 'ORE' AND mode IN ('buy', 'sell');

assertions.name: DB-driven planet goods: Planet has multiple commodities in planet_goods
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id = (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'Test Planet Deposit') AND cnt >= 2;

assertions.name: Commodity table: ALT commodity exists with illegal=false
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ALT' AND illegal = false;
